kept.spine: Everyone here knows what goes out and what comes in. The same carts carry both ways.
Warmholz sells several things outward and leans on no single one of them. The list is wide enough to lose one line and keep the trade standing.
Every season, Warmholz feeds itself with a small margin, coming out a little ahead without much drama.
The town works salt it cannot raise itself. Warmholz buys it in the way other towns grow their own, and that is a settled part of the craft.
